preconditions.description: Attacker must have owner or admin privileges to modify numConfirmationsRequired variable

exploit_hint: Call the function that modifies numConfirmationsRequired (likely a setter function accessible only to owner/admin) to set it to 1, bypassing the multisig confirmation requirement. Then execute transactions that would normally require multiple confirmations with only a single signature. Note: The provided source code shows WBNB contract which does not contain multisig functionality - the vulnerability description references WorldToken.sol which is not included in the provided code.
